name: aquarium
description: AI Fleet engineering workflows for governed design, documentation, delivery, review, validation, testing, and release lifecycle management.

interface.shortDescription: Engineer reliable software with AI Fleets.
interface.longDescription: Aquarium turns fleets of AI agents and development tools into governed, evidence-backed workflows for design, documentation governance, task and epic delivery, bounded review and remediation loops, common test setup, release-candidate QA with cumulative lifecycle management, and optional graph-backed execution memory.
defaultPrompt: Use $aquarium:new-project, $aquarium:new-feature, $aquarium:refactor, or $aquarium:war-room for explicit design work.
Use $aquarium:task-handler or $aquarium:epic-handler for delivery, $aquarium:release-handler for releases, and $aquarium:dev-setup, $aquarium:docs-setup, or $aquarium:test-setup for setup.
